title: Onboard vela-pro-13b-v1.2: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Natalie Park
description: Onboard vela-pro-13b v1.2 into the model registry with updated metadata, performance profiles for our standard inference targets, and automated changelog generation for release notes. Motivation: v1.2 includes revised quantization-friendly gates and improved KV cache packing which materially improves throughput on T4/A10G and latency on A100 for short- and medium-length sequences. This PR adds a canonical model card (models/vela-pro/metadata.yaml), multiple perf profiles (perf-profiles/vela-pro-13b-v1.2.json) for different hardware/sequence-length buckets, an automated changelog entry template and the automation hook that inserts profile diffs into the release notes, and updates the registry onboarding script to emit standardized metadata used by the console and documentation site. Checklist: 1) model metadata (name, architecture, tokenizer, weights location, license, recommended quantization) - added and validated; 2) perf profiles for short/medium/long sequences (1-64, 65-512, 512-2048 tokens) across GPU classes - benchmarks attached; 3) changelog automation: script to generate /changelogs/<model>-<version>.md from profile diffs and commit messages - unit-tested; 4) integration smoke test added to perf-canary pipeline to validate that the listed profiles run end-to-end on CI hardware. Testing: local perf runs (t4/a10g/a100), unit tests for changelog automation, and CI run that executes the smoke profile on a small A10G instance. Impact: new model available in catalog with recommended configs and automatic release notes. Related Linear items: ENG-2021 (onboard vela-pro), ENG-2104 (perf profile automation).
